selection_basis: Coverage-based: nine positive resource types and create/read/list/patch, including a scale subresource. Fixed before withheld-API model calls; existing baseline results already existed. No withheld-API outcomes used for selection.
removal_policy: Each trial independently starts from the original 30 records and excludes only that query’s verified correct_api, then fits a new TF-IDF vectorizer on the 29 descriptions. No cumulative removals.
prompt_policy: Reuse gorilla_eval.make_prompt verbatim; only retrieved cards change. Do not disclose the exclusion or gold labels to either model.
settings_policy: Keep each model’s baseline settings, including temperature 0 and Qwen non-thinking mode/output limit. Abort before generation if an unchanged Qwen prompt cannot fit.
attempt_policy: One attempt per query per model, no automatic retries or fallback models. Preserve API errors separately.
primary_refusal: HTTP success, complete generation, and response stripped of surrounding whitespace equals the bare token NO_MATCHING_API. A fence-normalized rate is reported separately.
availability_scope: Availability means offered among the current three retrieved API descriptions. Also distinguish removed correct API, remaining-index-but-not-retrieved API, and real SDK API outside the original catalog. This is not a cluster feature-availability test.
